verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's docs describe one-click launch of prebuilt templates, including a PyTorch template ready for deep learning with Jupyter. Template images are cached on many hosts, so instances start quickly. The rest of the requested stack is thinner: vLLM and ComfyUI appear only as copyable deployment examples, not explicitly as prebuilt templates, and no CUDA base template is named. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of vLLM, ComfyUI and CUDA prebuilt templates, and independent or hands-on corroboration of template launches.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch from pre-built ML templates (PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM, ComfyUI) instead of assembling an environment from scratch

citations.quote: Launch prebuilt or custom templates with one click.
PyTorch - Ready for deep learning with Jupyter; TensorFlow - ML development environment; Stable Diffusion - Image generation UIs
A template is how Vast helps you launch an instance, setting up your rented machine with whatever software and formatting you need.
Despite their large size you'll find they generally start quickly because they have been cached on many of the host machines.
